about: One staging contract, two readers. build/shared_output.rs (stage_tree) STAGES the frontend; scripts/sidecar_provenance.py (staged) JUDGES a staged tree. Each builds `source` in a scratch directory (a file's bytes are its own path) and must stage, or accept, exactly the files listed for the profile. A dot entry of the source is never staged, at any depth; a release profile also leaves out the top-level test tree, and only that one.
